purpose: Attribute the four source-backed whole-waveform public residuals to sampled peak anchoring versus independently fitted sub-sample peaks and a fixed orbital-frequency anchor. This is descriptive, with no optimized relative fit.
interpretation: Compare each waveform against the same pinned public binary after fitting each own peak or crossing independently. A smaller residual shows an anchoring artifact; it is not a physical fidelity pass, and no gate is changed.
